text: Tara joined the Barnes Center at Syracuse University as a Data & Research Intern

Tara joined the NIH-funded Summer Training in Alcohol and Health Research (STAHR-U) Program as a Graduate Research Assistant, mentoring undergraduate scholars in alcohol, substance use, and behavioral health research under Dr. Aesoon Park (Program Director) at Syracuse University.
Tara co-authored a book chapter, 'Who Does Singlehood Best? Personality Differences in Singlehood,' that was published in the Oxford Handbook of Singlehood.
Tara served as instructor for Psychology 252: Statistical Methods II at Syracuse University.
Tara co-authored a paper, 'Who Lives a Good Single Life? From Basic Need Satisfaction to Attachment, Sociosexuality, and Reasons for Being Single,' that was published in Personal Relationships.
